rules.title: Pydantic models
rules.text: Define request and response bodies as Pydantic models and set response_model.

rules.title: Dependency injection
rules.text: Use Depends for database sessions, auth and settings.

rules.title: Do not block the event loop
rules.text: Use async def only with non-blocking calls; run blocking work in a threadpool.

rules.title: APIRouter modules
rules.text: Split endpoints into APIRouter modules by domain.

rules.title: HTTPException with codes
rules.text: Raise HTTPException with accurate status codes and consistent error bodies.

rules.title: Lifespan events
rules.text: Create and close shared resources in the lifespan handler.

rules.title: Declare status codes
rules.text: Set status_code on routes and document error responses.

rules.title: Background tasks sparingly
rules.text: Use BackgroundTasks only for short work; use a queue for anything important.
